primary_view_domain: five nonreference generated target views, grid indices1..5; firstgrid tile is exactsource input, kept separately
object_aggregation: arithmetic mean of five per-view metrics; objects equally weighted
source_view: index0 quality separately descriptive, not pooled into primary
quality_failures: retain all valid executions, no output-based exclusion
test: two-sided paired sign-flip mean; MonteCarlo200000 common deterministic seed20261010 and plus-one adjustment for N50; exact when N<=20
effect_sign: raw a-b; lpips/ciede2000 lower is better, psnr/ssim higher is better
scope: same v29 UNet weights; geometry architectures and historical training differ; not algorithm-only causal test
metric_implementation: reuse evaluate_fresh_c_native_egl.load_metric_implementations; rawPNG encodedRGB [0,1], per-view512, sameGT mask; GTself and foreground validity calibrate before outputs
